_guide.doc: Master index cho 1 level. App bo qua key bat dau bang '_'.
_guide.page: Neu bai co truong page (vd bai.html) thi bam Hoc se vao thang trang do (bai kieu slide, du lieu o <level>/bai/<id>.json). Khong co thi vao vocabulary.html nhu cu.
_guide.structure: Moi 'lesson' = 1 Bai hoan chinh (id trong mam/items/<id>.json), dung khung 6 tab: vocab/grammar/listening/reading/preClass/postClass. Khong con chia A/B/C/D/Practical/Revise nua.
_guide.status: 'ready' = da co file noi dung | 'todo' = chua soan, the se mo 'sap ra mat'

lessons.title: Chào bạn, bạn có khoẻ không?
